{{Quote|And I don't like what I do. ''[...]'' But somebody has to do it, and I'm that somebody. I didn't choose it &mdash; it was chosen for me, when the jacks came to Okator.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Okator VIII''', also known as '''Okator''', was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] astronomical object located in the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]]. It had a [[Temperature/Legends|chilly]] climate and a surface that featured [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-covered hills. The fauna of Okator VIII included [[nightscowl]]s, [[shakwulf]]s, and [[Whellay/Legends|whellays]]. During the [[Standard century/Legends|century]]-long [[Tionese War]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]], a family from the celestial body [[Little Atullus]] moved to Okator VIII after buying a land [[Unidentified farm (Okator VIII)|property]] there. The family established a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] and made a living by herding whellays and growing various [[Plant/Legends|plants]].

[[Standard month/Legends|Months]] before the war's end, [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Tionjack|warships]] carried out an [[Attack on Okator VIII|attack]] on Okator VIII, destroying several settlements there. The young [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|boy]] of the [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] family also witnessed the destruction of [[Gender/Legends|his]] farm during the attack. Eventually leaving Okator VIII, the boy enlisted with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] but did not see action in combat before the war came to a close. Twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after being assigned to the Republic [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] [[Falang Minor]], the [[Republic soldier|soldier]] narrated an account of the attack on Okator VIII that he imprinted on a [[Baragwin sense lattice]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Okator VIII wasn't lush &mdash; it was chilly and the soil was poor. But land was cheap, the soil could be improved with effort, and the native whellays were gentle beasts that took easily to domestication.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
Okator VIII, also known simply as Okator, was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Okator system/Legends|Okator system]], a part of the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Tionese War]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Okator VIII was situated in the region known as [[the Divide]] and was located off the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] that connected the Republic's core regions with the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], in what was later known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Okator VIII was illuminated by a single [[Star/Legends|sun]] and had a [[Temperature/Legends|chilly]] climate. Its surface featured [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-covered hills. The soil on the celestial body was poor but could be improved with effort, and [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on Okator VIII grew [[charsby]] [[Plant/Legends|orchards]], [[galt-gourd]]s, and [[saria]]. The fauna of the astronomical object included [[shakwulf]]s and [[Whellay/Legends|whellays]], which could both be domesticated, as well as the forest [[Diet/Legends|predators]] known as [[nightscowl]]s.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==History==
===A boy's childhood===
{{Quote|And I got used to farm life. ''[...]'' At first I only tolerated it. Then I realized I was happy.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
During the Tionese War,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> fought for roughly a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] beginning in [[24,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a group of [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] from<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] promised a family on the<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Little Atullus">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Little Atullus system/Legends|Little Atullus system]]</ref> celestial body [[Little Atullus]] cheap land on Okator VIII. The parents of the family invested their life savings into a [[Unidentified farm (Okator VIII)|property]] on the astronomical object and moved there, taking their [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|young son]] with them.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Over [[Time/Legends|time]], the family developed a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] on their land, maintaining a herd of the local whellays and fields where several types of plants were grown. The family sometimes went into the local [[City/Legends|town]] where they would learn the latest news regarding the ongoing war against the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]]; however, the family's boy dismissed the relevance of the conflict to them due to the remote location of Okator VIII. Eventually, the boy grew to like life at a farm, taking a special liking to [[Gender/Legends|his]] favorite shakwulf, [[Brun (shakwulf)|Brun]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

===Tionese attack===
{{Quote|I heard that's why they chose us. I heard they were tired of killing a few blocks worth of people on some city-world so big that the deaths were just a statistic. I heard they looked for a place where they could kill everybody.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier, on the Tionese|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
[[File:PerlemianCorridor22kBBY-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|260px|During the Tionese War, warships from the Tion Cluster attacked Okator VIII (situated between Abhean and [[Roche]] in the red-colored territory).]]
At some point [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the war's end<ref name="Author's Cut" /> around [[23,900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a group of Tionese [[Tionjack]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Attack on Okator VIII|arrived]] at Okator VIII. Commencing an attack run on the celestial body's settlements, the Tionjacks destroyed [[Derway Township]] by dropping a [[pressure bomb]] on it. At the time, the farm-boy was tracking a lost whellay in the forests together with Brun, and he witnessed both the destruction of Derway and the subsequent decimation of the [[Duny Gap]] and [[Shillagh Hollow]] settlements. A Tionjack then prepared to destroy the farm of the boy's family, and both Brun and the boy rushed to their home, only for the boy to witness the warship [[Fire/Legends|burn]] everything there, including property and animals, via the use of a [[Plasma torch/Legends|plasma torch]]. At that point, with their task accomplished, the Tionese warships left Okator VIII.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, a [[Courier/Legends|courier]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on a business errand from the celestial body [[Hleua]] arrived on Okator VIII, discovering the destruction of Derway Township. The boy was able to hail a [[Scout ship/Legends|scoutship]] that took him off-world, in what turned out to be last time he&mdash;or anyone else, to his knowledge&mdash;saw Okator VIII. Although the boy was encouraged to tell the story of the attack on Okator VIII on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the Republic,<ref name="TEA" /> he instead enlisted in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] at [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which was at that time the farthest major Republic world.<ref name="EGTW" />

Before the young [[Republic soldier]] could exact his vengeance upon the Tionese in combat, however, the war ended. The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] was eventually assigned to [[Falang Minor]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> one of a series of Republic [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]] established<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> along the Coreward boundaries of the Tion Cluster.<ref name="EGTW" /> After twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of monitoring starship traffic, intelligence, and transmissions originating in the [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|watchmen]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the soldier imprinted on a [[Baragwin sense lattice]] an audio-visual account of the attack on Okator VIII. In the record, the former farm-boy noted that he had heard the reason why the Tionese had selected Okator VIII for their attack instead of a major Republic [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world]] was that they wanted to attack a location where they could "[[Death/Legends|kill]] everybody."<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|And I saw the glint of the Tionese ships above Duny Gap and Shillagh Hollow. ''[...]'' I saw the gas billow up above Duny and knew that everybody there was dead. Then the flames came shooting up from Shillagh.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The inhabitants of Okator VIII included a family of farmers originally from the celestial body Little Atullus. Beside the family's farm, there were also several settlements on Okator VIII. The astronomical object was regularly visited by Republic [[tradeship]]s and couriers from Hleua. These starships relied on the [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace jump-beacon]] at [[Uthtara]] for their visits to Okator VIII, and when the jump-beacon occasionally experienced malfunctions, the vessels would not visit the astronomical object for weeks.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|I got up and saw the trees on the Pinson ridge had been flattened, pointing away from Derway Township.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The settlement of Derway Township was located on Okator VIII, beyond the natural formation known as the [[Pinson ridge]]. In addition, the settlements of Duny Gap and Shillagh Hollow were separated by a ridge from a valley where a farm owned by a family of farmers lay.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I created Uthtara as part of a first-person remembrance of a Tionese attack on a Republic frontier world. I had to cut the vignette ''[...]''.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/20907109370/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-2|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 2}}</ref>}}
Okator VIII was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the astronomical object,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which Fry characterized in his personal blog as a "Republic frontier world,"<ref name="Tumblr" /> was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Okator VIII was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Okator [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Okator VIII, in grid square Q-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
